record.issue_text: MultiEmail uses array index as React key in value.map, which can cause stale input state on removal/reordering; prefer a stable id per row

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the list rendering uses the array index as the React key: `value.map((field, index) => (<li key={index}> ... ))`. Because this component supports removing items (`updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`), using index keys can cause React to reuse the wrong child instance after deletions, which can lead to stale per-row component state/focus (especially if `EmailField` maintains internal state). This is a concrete, diff-grounded issue, but not a guaranteed defect given the inputs are controlled by `value`.
